results.title: Gilbert Houngbo re-elected to lead UN labour agency for second term
results.content: Former Togo prime minister Gilbert Houngbo has secured a second five-year term as head of the UN's International Labour Organization. His re-election came after his only challenger, Spain's Labour Minister, withdrew at the last minute. Houngbo says he's ready to continue the agency's work.

results.title: South Africa reels from deadly mass shootings as residents demand arrests
results.content: South Africa is investigating two mass shootings that have left 17 people dead. Nine bodies were found in an informal settlement near Pretoria, while another attack took place outside Pietermaritzburg. Police are investigating as residents voice growing frustration over the relentless killings.

results.title: Kenyan farmers race to protect crops and soil ahead of El Niño rains
results.content: Dark clouds are gathering over central Kenya, and farmers are racing to protect their crops. In Limuru, Elizabeth Itotia knows the risks all too well. Two years ago, heavy rains washed away much of her farm’s topsoil.

results.title: US airports slowly return to normal after three days of disruption

results.title: Algeria threatens to target drug traffickers at 'source' amid Morocco tensions
results.content: Algeria is declaring war on drugs. President Abdelmadjid Tebboune is threatening tougher action, warning that the fight must target the source of the problem.

results.title: Congo struggles to tame ebola outbreak six months into response
results.content: More than 11,000 cases have been recorded, and nearly half of those infected have died, according to government data. It is the deadliest of Congo’s 17 outbreaks and is on track to surpass the death toll from the West African outbreak that killed 11,000 people between 2014 and 2016

results.title: DR Congo-Rwanda tensions force Francophonie leadership election delay until 2027
